page_title: AUG 2-3 BAY | Augsburg v Bayern Munich 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+8' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+6' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
90+6' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) has tested the patience of referee Florian Exner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+5' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+5' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.
90+3' A player from Augsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+3' Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
90+3' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Augsburg have a corner.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch for Han-Noah Massengo.
90' Mert Komur (Augsburg) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
88' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:9.
87' The resulting set piece from Bayern Munich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

87' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) shows good awareness deep inside the box and jumps high to meet a perfect cross from the set piece. He steers a fine header goalwards, but finds the keeper prepared. No doubt about the wonderful save that he made. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
86' Substitution. Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) replaces Serge Gnabry.
85' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
84' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg). Augsburg earn a corner.
83' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
81' One of the players from Augsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' A player from Augsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
77' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
76' 2 - 3 Goal! Great play by Kristijan Jakic releases Mert Komur (Augsburg) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 2:3.
73' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Konrad Laimer as he is replaced by Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich).
71' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Leon Goretzka will be replaced by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich).
68' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayern Munich.
64' Dimitrios Giannoulis just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Anton Kade (Augsburg) replaces him.
64' Sandro Wagner has decided to make a change. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) replaces Elias Saad.
62' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
59' The referee shows a yellow card to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
59' Corner kicks – 5:3.
57' A corner kick by Bayern Munich is thwarted by the well prepared Finn Dahmen (Augsburg).

57' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
53' 1 - 3 Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.

52' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Finn Dahmen to get hold of the ball.
48' 0 - 3 Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Finn Dahmen with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:3.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' 0 - 2 Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
45+3' Bayern Munich couldn't find the way to score from a close-range free kick as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
45+2' Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

43' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
42' The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
39' Marius Wolf is substituted due to injury. Sandro Wagner gives a chance to Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
38' The game is interrupted now, Marius Wolf (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
34' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
33' This will be a very dangerous free kick from just outside the box and it's a very promising distance, indeed. Let's see what Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will come up with.
31' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
31' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane picks out Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 0:1.
27' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) commits a foul and Florian Exner immediately signals a free kick.
22' The ball possession at the moment is 38:62.
19' Excellent touch by Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.

16' Ambitious effort from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
14' Elias Saad (Augsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman signals a throw-in for Augsburg.
10' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich have a free kick.
9' Some patient build-up play from Bayern Munich as they look to unlock the defence.
5' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
5' Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Finn Dahmen.
2' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Florian Exner.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
